- Build a complete, playable Portuguese-language open-world game inspired by GTA, with a story, multiple missions, character switching/customization, and a large city.

- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Include story mode, fun missions, character switching and customization, and a large city.

- Created “Neon Bay,” a browser-based 2D top-down city game with fictional cargo trading rather than real-world drug mechanics.
- Added keyboard and touch controls, vehicles, minimap, mission progression, customization, and local save data.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented city generation, missions, trading, vehicles, customization, controls, and save/load logic in `game.js`.
